Keepiq in Chrome, Firefox en Edge: Keepiq in Chrome, Firefox and Edge
de pop-up bij zaken.zuiddrecht.nl, alle: the pop-up on zaken.zuiddrecht.nl, all values masked

Gedeeld door Anouk Bakker, alleen gebrui: Shared by Anouk Bakker, use only
Het wachtwoordbeleid van uw organisatie: Your organisation's password policy sets the minimum length (16) and the character types. Those choices are fixed.
Zonder wachtwoord bevat de link de sleut: Without a password the link holds the key: anyone with the link can open the message. With a password, you share that password another way.
Keepiq vergrendelt ook als uw computer v: Keepiq also locks when your computer locks. Your administrator allows at most 30 minutes.
Ontgrendelen met vingerafdruk of gezicht: Set up unlocking with fingerprint or face
The PIN works until you close the browser. After five wrong PINs, Keepiq asks for your master password.
Aanbieden om een gewijzigd wachtwoord bi: Offer to update a changed password
Een sterk wachtwoord voorstellen in aanm: Suggest a strong password in sign-in fields
Vergrendeld: pincode, biometrie of ander: Locked: PIN, biometrics or other device
Of ontgrendel hieronder met uw hoofdwach: Or unlock below with your master password.
Uw hoofdwachtwoord wordt alleen in deze: Your master password is only used in this extension to decrypt your vault. It never reaches the server.
Open Keepiq op een apparaat waarop uw kl: Open Keepiq on a device where your vault is unlocked and approve this request there. Check that the same words appear there.
Gebruik een Nextcloud-app-wachtwoord (In: Use a Nextcloud app password (Settings, Security), not your sign-in password. Disconnecting removes it again.
De server weigerde het app-wachtwoord va: The server refused this account's app password. Sign in again with a new app password.
Deze extensieversie heeft een nieuwere K: This extension version needs a newer Keepiq on your Nextcloud server. Ask your administrator to update it.
In een aanmeldveld stelt de extensie een: In a sign-in field the extension suggests a strong password and fills in a one-time code in the step after signing in. After a form is sent, it asks whether to save or update the login. A passkey request from a site is caught and answered with a passkey from the vault. You can also fill in through the context menu and a shortcut. An https login on an http page asks for confirmation first.
